scope: Five real cases; full caption reading for first four; partial controlled ASR for two; visual text reading for fifth.
verdict: Core evidence-reading paths work; animated values, recognition errors, and dense-text coverage require active rereading.

measurements.preparation_note: First four prepared with up to three concurrent workers; science cache reused. Fifth prepared separately. Not a controlled performance benchmark.

observations.finding: Initial snapshots catch the animated counters, not final limits. Nearby stable frames agree with captions.
At 795s only F= appears; at 800s F=qv is still incomplete. Later sampled frames change scenes. Complete formula was not visually established; do not infer it from an incomplete frame.

observations.corrected_using: Later spoken text plus visible 项目意识 at 25.733s
observations.finding: Functional ASR success is not a guarantee of exact transcription.

observations.visible_document: 随机完整UR旅鸟×1、旅鸟招募券×100
observations.finding: The announcement screenshot supports a random UR, not a choice. The burnt-in yellow caption also says 随机. Caption source wording must not override visible evidence.

Default 24-frame sampling is about 26.1s apart; some snapshots contain only connectors. The 0-32s visual reread at 2s intervals reveals the missing paragraph. Full video text coverage was not established.

answer_examples.question: 这一集讲什么？
answer_examples.answer: 介绍 TEM 与 SEM，重点沿 TEM 的电子源、加速、磁透镜、薄样品、放大和探测链路解释，再比较 SEM 与 STEM。
answer_examples.evidence: All 239 caption segments, 24 overview frames, and 10 followup frames.

answer_examples.question: 为什么先用磷光屏，再换 CMOS？
answer_examples.answer: 视频说明磷光屏用于对准和概览，正确设置后移开屏幕，以更灵敏的 CMOS 捕获图像，避免失焦电子束损伤相机。
answer_examples.evidence: Captions 863.55-908.63s; viewed frames at 875, 886 and 900s show screen and mechanical motion.

answer_examples.question: 开头说的牛腿问题指什么？
answer_examples.answer: 画面显示轨道下方的三角支座未直接托住轨道；讲解质疑它是否真正承担支撑作用。

answer_examples.question: 公告补偿的是 UR 自选吗？
answer_examples.answer: 截图写随机完整 UR 和 100 张招募券，且限定已创建角色的指定服务器账号。
answer_examples.evidence: Viewed announcement frames at 53.067s and 70.767s; AI wording conflicts with screenshot.

answer_examples.question: 开头的画面正文在表达什么？
answer_examples.answer: 作者批评用十六种人格快速筛选和呈现自己，并将其视为预先规定主体的框架。这是作者的论述，未在本轮评判其哲学或心理学结论。
answer_examples.evidence: Visible text sampled every 2s in 0-32s; no captions or ASR used.

limits: Not an independent accuracy benchmark or a claim of continuous audiovisual perception.
The third and fourth online videos actually expose AI captions; no-caption ASR was tested by opening the same downloaded media as local files without subtitles.
Only 0-90s of the VTuber video and 120-180s of the game video were locally transcribed.
The fifth video received visual overview and 0-32s dense rereading, not full transcription or full text extraction.
Music, sound effects, tone and brief motions were not assessed as raw audio/video.
next_priority: Improve host reading guidance for animated values, text-heavy sequences, and caption/visual disagreements before adding platform or recommendation features.
